items.title: A Grothendieck abelian category has functorial injective embeddings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The theorem states that every Grothendieck abelian category has functorial injective embeddings (statement lines 1715-1719). The proof is a complete argument: the author runs a transfinite construction that adjoins, at each successor ordinal, a solution of one extension problem, taking colimits at limit ordinals (proof lines 1721-1750); smallness makes the process stop, which yields a functorially defined object (proof lines 1750-1755); and the stabilised object satisfies the injectivity criterion because the next step of the construction would solve any extension problem (proof lines 1755-1759). The non-formal content is the transfinite construction and its termination. The claim is H3.
